notes: Skrini ya bluu inarudi juu ya kufuli ya Watu yenyewe baada ya kidirisha au sasisho (1.13.0 ilikaa chini yake hadi simu izimwe); swichi ya WiFi inaruhusiwa ndani ya kidirisha wakati kitufe kimefunguliwa; ripoti ya simu haivuti skrini juu ya kidirisha wakati mteja anaandika nenosiri. / The blue screen puts itself back above Watu's lock after a panel or an update (1.13.0 stayed under it until a restart); the Wi-Fi switch inside the panel is allowed while the button holds it open; a beat no longer drags the screen over a panel while a password is being typed.
